Optimizer settings for the sem engine

Source: R/sem-control.R
sem_control.Rd

Builds the control argument of fit_sem() and mbco_sem() (and of fit_mediation() with engine = "sem", through engine_args = list(control = )). A plain list is still accepted there and keeps its earlier meaning: every entry is an nloptr option, exactly as sem_control(nloptr = <list>).

Usage

sem_control(optimizer = "auto", n_starts = NULL, nloptr = list())

Arguments

optimizer

Character: "auto" (default) leaves the algorithm to the engine (SLSQP for a listwise fit, unless nloptr names another algorithm; the fixed SLSQP-plus-nlminb protocol for FIML). "slsqp" requests SLSQP explicitly; it gives the same fit as "auto", and naming a different nloptr algorithm with it is an error. FIML accepts only "auto".

n_starts

Positive integer or NULL (default): the number of starts, as the n_starts argument of fit_sem(). Giving it both here and at the top level is an error unless the two agree. NULL uses the top-level value, or the default of the estimator (5 listwise, 3 for FIML).

nloptr

Named list of options passed to nloptr for a listwise fit (for example list(maxeval = 20000L)). The empty list (default) keeps the engine's options. FIML requires the empty list.

Value

An object of class medfit_sem_control: a list with elements optimizer, n_starts and nloptr.

Details

The resolved search protocol of a fit (estimator, the algorithm that ran, the number of starts and the start rule) is recorded in fit@diagnostics$protocol.

A top-level n_starts that differs in value from sem_control(n_starts = ), or optimizer = "slsqp" with a different nloptr algorithm, stops with an error of class medfit_error_sem_control_conflict.

See also

fit_sem(), mbco_sem()

Examples

ctl <- sem_control(nloptr = list(maxeval = 20000L))
ctl
#> <sem_control>
#>   optimizer: auto 
#>   n_starts:  default 
#>   nloptr:    maxeval = 20000 
fit <- fit_sem("mediator1 ~ a*treatment\noutcome ~ b*mediator1 + cp*treatment",
               mediation_demo, control = ctl)
fit@diagnostics$protocol
#> $version
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $estimator
#> [1] "listwise"
#> 
#> $optimizer
#> [1] "NLOPT_LD_SLSQP"
#> 
#> $n_starts
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $start_rule
#> [1] "model_start_then_perturbed"
#>
